Do you prefer to use your hand or a pick to strum your guitar?
How do you prefer to strum?

Depends on what I am playing. I generally find it easier to add in more dynamic to what I am doing if I play without a pick. I quite like fingerpicking too, so I like to be able to quickly switch between the two styles. But then some songs need a load of attack so pick is the way to go.

You pretty much summed up my thoughts. I would add that different songs can call for different pick thicknesses as well. If I'm trying to get a more uniform chord sound I'll usually go with a thinner pick (.73mm), and if I'm playing something that has more individual note lines that I need to stick out I'll go with a thicker pick (1.14mm or 1.50mm).

To be honest I've never really experimented with picks much. I always use my trusty Dunlop Nylon .73s since I've never found something that feels more comfortable to me, but I'll try out some different thicknesses sometime and see how it goes.

Good luck experimenting! I'd stick with Dunlop for brand (they've been my go-to for years now). If you're looking for some changes, I'd also recommend giving their Tortex line a try - in my opinion they grip extremely well in your fingers.
Tortexs are great versatile picks. I always keep a couple in my wallet and jeans, great picks to have around.

I am definitly using my hand ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

Jokes aside, fingerpicking is my thing.

As a jazz guitarist, it depends on the sound that I'm going for.

At lower dynamics, I prefer to use my fingers to comp. As the energy increases, I'll tend to switch to hybrid picking, and if I want a real crisp, driving sound, I'll use my pick (a heavy 1.2mm one).

It really depends on the sound you're going after, the genre of the music, and the guitar you're playing though!

Fingerpicking... kind of. I can't handle using a pick, I need to FEEL the strings with my skin. When I'm playing particularly fast passages, I kind of "flick" the strings with my index finger rapid-fire like. The rest of the time, it kind of looks like I'm slapping clumsily at the guitar but to me it just feels natural. Some old bandmates used to call me "Monkeypaw" because of my weird-ass style.

The short answer is that it depends on what I'm playing. If I need more volume, I'll use a pick. If I need more dynamics, I'll use my fingers. The nail on my right forefinger is pretty much always missing the corner of the nail from shattering it on the strings on downstrokes. When I strum hard with the fingers, I tend to use more of a flamenco technique.
